$comment: The telemetry-key registry (TL-1). A key is never renamed and never removed, only deprecated; `since` is the package version the key first shipped in. Generated into src/telemetry-keys.ts by scripts/generate-telemetry-keys.mjs — run `pnpm -C packages/core generate` after editing this file. Attribute names follow OpenTelemetry's `gen_ai.*` vocabulary where one exists (TL-2); `attributes` is filled per key by the pull request that starts emitting it.

keys.description: An Affidavit was filed as a Docket entry.
A proposal was refused before filing because it swore to nothing (GT-3).
A tool the gate must cover could not be intercepted, or a tool the host declared uncovered produced a proposal (CV-4).
A pending Docket entry passed its expiry (DK-3).
A decision was refused on identity grounds: no resolved principal, another tenant, or the host's authorization port said no (AZ-2).
A Standing Order policy approved a write with no person present (AZ-1).
A Standing Order verdict was not honoured: an unbound provenance input (PV-4), or a risk score above the policy's threshold (GT-5).
